words.definition: The branch of philosophy concerned with the nature and scope of knowledge
words.definationTranslation: Gyān ke svabhāv aur dāyrā se sambandhit darśanśāstra ka śākhā

sentence.sentence: The teacher's epistemology influenced her approach to student learning.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ke jñānaśāstra ne chātr ko siksha dene ke tarike ko prabhāvit kiya.

sentence.sentence: The constructivist theory is based on a specific epistemology that views knowledge as constructed.
sentence.translation: Nirmitvādi siddhānt ek vishisht jñānaśāstra par ādharit hai jo gyān ko nirmit dekhti hai.

words.definition: A learning theory that suggests that people construct their own understanding of the world
words.definationTranslation: Ek sikhne ki siddhānt jo kehta hai ki log apne SWAT: apne aas-paas ke sansār ko nirmit karte hain

sentence.sentence: Constructivism emphasizes the role of the learner in the learning process.
sentence.translation: Nirmitvāda siddhānt siksha prakriyā mein chātr ke bhūmikā par jor deti hai.

sentence.sentence: The teacher facilitated a constructivist approach to learning by encouraging students to ask questions.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne chātron ko sawāl pūchhne ke liye protsahan karke nirmitvādi sikhne ki drishti pradaan ki.

words.definition: A mental framework or concept that helps organize and interpret information
words.definationTranslation: Ek mānusik sanrachnā ya avdhārnā jo suchna ko vyavasthit aur vyākhya karne mein madad karti hai

sentence.sentence: The student's schema about the topic was influenced by her prior knowledge and experiences.
sentence.translation: Chātr ke vishay ke bare mein yojanā uske pūrva gyan aur anubhav se prabhāvit thi.

sentence.sentence: The teacher helped students to develop a schema for understanding complex concepts.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne chātron ko jatil avdhārnā ko samajhne ke liye yojanā viksit karne mein madad ki.

words.definition: The process of adjusting one's existing schema to fit new information
words.definationTranslation: Naye suchna ko apne asitit yojanā mein samāne ke liye samayojan prakriyā

sentence.sentence: The learner had to make an accommodation in her schema to incorporate new ideas.
sentence.translation: Chātr ko apne yojanā mein naye vichār ko shaamil karne ke liye samayojan karnā padā.

sentence.sentence: The teacher encouraged students to engage in accommodation by challenging their existing beliefs.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne chātron ko unke asitit vishvāson ko chunauti dene ke dwārā samayojan mein bhāg lene ke liye protsahan kiya.

words.definition: The process of incorporating new information into one's existing schema
words.definationTranslation: Naye suchna ko apne asitit yojanā mein shaamil karne ki prakriyā

sentence.sentence: The student's assimilation of new concepts helped her to develop a deeper understanding of the subject.
sentence.translation: Chātr ke naye avdhārnā ko sāmanvay karne se uski vishay ke bare mein gehri samajh viksit hui.

sentence.sentence: The teacher facilitated assimilation by providing students with opportunities to practice new skills.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne chātron ko naye kaushal ko abhyās karne ke avsar pradaan karke sāmanvay ki sucna di.

words.definition: A region or area where a particular activity or process takes place
words.definationTranslation: Ek vishisht kshetra ya kshetr jahan ek vishisht gatividhi ya prakriyā hoti hai

sentence.sentence: The zone of proximal development is a key concept in constructivist learning theory.
sentence.translation: Aasannatmaka vikās kshetra nirmitvādi sikhne ki siddhānt ka ek mahatvapoorn avdhārna hai.

sentence.sentence: The teacher created a zone of comfort and safety for her students to learn and grow.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne apne chātron ke liye ek suvidhājanak aur surakshit kshetra banaaye jahan ve sikh sakein aur badh sakein.

words.definition: Close or nearby in space, time, or relationship
words.definationTranslation: Sthaan, samay, ya sambandh mein nikat ya aas-paas

sentence.sentence: The proximal development zone is where learners are challenged to learn new concepts.
sentence.translation: Aasannatmaka vikās kshetra vah jagah hai jahan chātron ko naye avdhārnā sikhne ke liye chunauti di jati hai.

sentence.sentence: The teacher provided proximal support to her students by offering feedback and guidance.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne apne chātron ko feedback aur margadarshan pradan karke aasannatmaka sahāyata pradaan ki.

words.definition: The shared understanding or agreement between individuals
words.definationTranslation: Vyaktiyon ke beech sahya samajh ya sammati

sentence.sentence: The teacher encouraged intersubjectivity by promoting class discussions and debates.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne varg charchā aur vād-vivād ko badhāvā dekar antarvastvikatā ko protsahan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The learners developed intersubjectivity through collaborative learning activities.
sentence.translation: Chātron ne sahyogik sikhne ki gatividhiyon ke dwārā antarvastvikatā viksit ki.

words.definition: The ability to act independently and make decisions
words.definationTranslation: Svatantrata se kārya karne aur nirnay lene ki kshamta

sentence.sentence: The teacher encouraged autonomy in her students by giving them choices and responsibilities.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne apne chātron ko svāyattatā ko badhāvā dene ke liye unhein pasand aur jimmedāriyan di.

sentence.sentence: The learners developed autonomy through self-directed learning activities.
sentence.translation: Chātron ne sv-nyasta sikhne ki gatividhiyon ke dwārā svāyattatā viksit ki.

words.definition: Guided or controlled by oneself
words.definationTranslation: Svayam dwārā margdarshan ya niyantran kiya gaya

sentence.sentence: The teacher encouraged self-directed learning by providing students with resources and support.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne chātron ko sansādhan aur sahāyata pradan karke sv-nyasta sikhne ko badhāvā diya.

sentence.sentence: The learners engaged in self-directed activities to develop their critical thinking skills.
sentence.translation: Chātron ne apne alopik chintan kaushal viksit karne ke liye sv-nyasta gatividhiyon mein bhāg liya.

words.definition: The art, science, or profession of teaching
words.definationTranslation: Shikshan ka kala, vigyān, ya vritti

sentence.sentence: The teacher's pedagogy was focused on creating a supportive learning environment.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ke shikshā-vidhi ka kendrīy bindu sahayak sikhne ka paryāvaran banāne par tha.

sentence.sentence: The school's pedagogy emphasized student-centered learning and community involvement.
sentence.translation: Vidhyālay ke shikshā-vidhi ne chātr-kendrit sikhne aur samudāyik bhāgidāri par jor diya.

words.definition: The art, science, or profession of teaching adults
words.definationTranslation: Vayaskon ko shikshan ka kala, vigyān, ya vritti

sentence.sentence: The instructor's andragogy was designed to meet the needs of adult learners.
sentence.translation: Prashikshak ke vayask-shikshā-vidhi ko vayask shiksharthiyon ke jazbat poora karne ke liye banāya gaya tha.

sentence.sentence: The training program's andragogy focused on self-directed learning and experiential learning.
sentence.translation: Prashikshan karyakram ke vayask-shikshā-vidhi ne sv-nyasta sikhne aur anubhavik sikhne par kendrit kiya.

words.definition: The art, science, or profession of teaching self-directed learning
words.definationTranslation: Sv-nyasta sikhne ka kala, vigyān, ya vritti

sentence.sentence: The teacher's heutagogy was focused on developing learners' autonomy and self-directed learning skills.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ke sv-nyasta-shikshā-vidhi ka kendrīy bindu chātron ki svāyattatā aur sv-nyasta sikhne ke kaushal ko viksit karne par tha.

sentence.sentence: The online course's heutagogy emphasized learner-centered and self-directed learning approaches.
sentence.translation: Online pāth-yakram ke sv-nyasta-shikshā-vidhi ne chātr-kendrit aur sv-nyasta sikhne ke drishtikon par jor diya.

words.definition: The process of thinking about and reflecting on one's own thinking
words.definationTranslation: Apne khud ke chintan ke bare mein sochne aur us par vimarsh karne ki prakriyā

sentence.sentence: The teacher encouraged meta-cognition by asking students to reflect on their learning process.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne chātron se apne sikhne ki prakriyā par vimarsh karne ke liye kahkar upar-chintan ko protsahan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The learners developed meta-cognition skills through journaling and self-assessment activities.
sentence.translation: Chātron ne dainik likhne aur sv-mulyānkhan gatividhiyon ke dwārā upar-chintan kaushal viksit kiye.

words.definition: The act of thinking carefully and thoughtfully about something
words.definationTranslation: Kisi cheez ke bare mein saavdhanipoorvak aur vichārpoorvak sochne ka kārya

sentence.sentence: The teacher encouraged reflection by asking students to write reflective journals.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne chātron se vimarshi dainik likhne ke liye kahkar vimarsh ko protsahan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The learners engaged in reflection by discussing their experiences and thoughts with their peers.
sentence.translation: Chātron ne apne anubhavon aur vichāron ko apne sahyogiyon ke saath charchā karke vimarsh kiya.

words.definition: A temporary support or framework to help learners achieve their goals
words.definationTranslation: Chātron ko unke lakshyon ko prāpt karne mein madad karne ke liye ek as्थayi sahāyata ya sanrachnā

sentence.sentence: The teacher provided scaffolding by giving students temporary support and guidance.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne chātron ko as्थayi sahāyata aur margadarshan pradan karke sahāyak sanrachnā pradaan ki.

sentence.sentence: The learners used scaffolding to build their knowledge and skills gradually.
sentence.translation: Chātron ne apne gyan aur kaushal ko dheere-dheere viksit karne ke liye sahāyak sanrachnā ka upyog kiya.

words.definition: The process of creating knowledge or meaning through collaboration
words.definationTranslation: Sahyog ke dwārā gyan ya arth ka utpādan ki prakriyā

sentence.sentence: The teacher facilitated co-construction by encouraging students to work together.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne chātron ko saath milkar kaam karne ke liye protsahan karke sah-utpādan ki sucna di.

sentence.sentence: The learners engaged in co-construction by sharing their ideas and perspectives.
sentence.translation: Chātron ne apne vichāron aur drishtikon ko saajha karke sah-utpādan kiya.

words.definition: A relationship between a learner and an experienced person
words.definationTranslation: Ek chātr aur anubhavi vyakti ke beech sambandh

sentence.sentence: The learner entered into an apprenticeship with an experienced craftsman.
sentence.translation: Chātr ne anubhavi kārupariya ke saath shikshu-pan kiya.

sentence.sentence: The teacher established an apprenticeship program to provide students with hands-on experience.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne chātron ko haath se anubhav pradan karne ke liye shikshu-pan karyakram sthāpित किया.

words.definition: A relationship between a learner and an experienced person who guides and supports them
words.definationTranslation: Ek chātr aur anubhavi vyakti ke beech sambandh jahaan vyakti margdarshan aur sahāyata karta hai

sentence.sentence: The teacher provided mentorship to her students by offering guidance and support.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne apne chātron ko margadarshan aur sahāyata pradan karke mārgdarshan diya.

sentence.sentence: The learners benefited from mentorship by receiving feedback and encouragement from their mentors.
sentence.translation: Chātron ne apne mārgdarshakon se feedback aur protsahan prāpt karke mārgdarshan se labh uthāya.

words.definition: Relating to or based on experience
words.definationTranslation: Anubhav se sambandhit ya us par ādharit

sentence.sentence: The teacher used experiential learning approaches to engage students in hands-on activities.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne chātron ko haath se gatividhiyon mein bhāg lene ke liye anubhavik sikhne ke drishtikon ka upyog kiya.

sentence.sentence: The learners developed experiential knowledge through direct experience and participation.
sentence.translation: Chātron ne pratākshik anubhav aur bhāgidāri ke dwārā anubhavik gyan viksit kiya.

words.definition: Relating to or considering the whole person
words.definationTranslation: Sampūrṇ vyakti se sambandhit ya us par vichār karte hue

sentence.sentence: The teacher used holistic approaches to education, considering the physical, emotional, and cognitive needs of students.
sentence.translation: Shikshak ne śikshā mein sampūrṇ drishtikon ka upyog kiya, chātron ke śārīrik, bhāvanātmak, aur mānsik āvashyaktaon par vichār karte hue.

sentence.sentence: The learners developed a holistic understanding of the subject through integrated learning activities.
sentence.translation: Chātron ne samarthit sikhne ki gatividhiyon ke dwārā vishay ka sampūrṇ samajh viksit kiya.
